alignment: Pace, pause, monotone, and volume measurements use plain forced alignment. Wildcard alignment is not run.

disabled_types.filler: No configured DEV-only threshold met the per-type false-region budget of 0.150/minute with positive target F1 in both modes.
disabled_types.monotone: No configured DEV-only threshold met the per-type false-region budget of 0.150/minute with positive target F1 in both modes.
disabled_types.pace_fast: No configured DEV-only threshold met the per-type false-region budget of 0.150/minute with positive target F1 in both modes.
disabled_types.pace_slow: No configured DEV-only threshold met the per-type false-region budget of 0.150/minute with positive target F1 in both modes.
disabled_types.stumble_repeat: No configured DEV-only threshold met the per-type false-region budget of 0.150/minute with positive target F1 in both modes.
disabled_types.volume_dropoff: No configured DEV-only threshold met the per-type false-region budget of 0.150/minute with positive target F1 in both modes.

fillers: Only stable voiced segments in inter-word gaps of the plain alignment are considered. Acoustic evidence cannot prove lexical content; controls and IDEAL rates are reported for review.
reference_free: Each DEV passage is scored against an IDEAL reference fitted on all other DEV IDEAL passages. No held-out passage contributes to its own reference.
stumbles: Stumble-repeat detection is disabled unless DEV tuning demonstrates positive F1 within its false-region budget; this bounded pipeline does not use ASR.
